description:
Initialization: Assign tasks (descending reward, then task ID) to candidate satellite with 
lowest assigned duration; tie-break by smaller ID. Unassigned if no candidates.

Reassignment (test unobserved task-satellite pairs from base schedule):
- Pair Sorting: Sort candidate pairs by descending (reward - penalty), then ascending task 
and satellite ID (penalties start at 0).
- Penalty Update: Increment pair penalty if trial is infeasible or task fails to be 
scheduled on target.
- Acceptance: Select feasible trial with highest total reward strictly above current 
schedule; retain first on tie.
- Termination: Stop when no candidate improves or the search budget expires.
